adult_gate.semantics: Server-evaluated adult-gate fact at token issuance. Domain PEPs grant learning access only on PASSED; any other value or absence denies.

consent_state.semantics: Server-evaluated learning-consent fact at token issuance: GRANTED only when every LEARNING-required consent matches the published document/policy digest. Domain PEPs deny on any other value or absence.

eligibilityClaims.freshness: Claims are frozen at issuance and bounded by maxLifetimeSeconds (900s). Consent withdrawal revokes sessions, so the next issuance re-evaluates; a withdrawn principal cannot ride an old token past its TTL.
eligibilityClaims.issuerChange: P1-LIVE-001: iam-service previously minted access tokens without these claims while domain PEPs already required them, so every authenticated learner request failed closed at the learner/learning boundary. Issuance now always evaluates both facts; evaluation failure fails the issuance itself, never mints an over-privileged token.

phase.semantics: Server deployment phase at issuance, from iam-service configuration. Social PEPs require phase-1; absence denies.

account_status.semantics: Issuance itself refuses non-ACTIVE accounts, so every minted token implies ACTIVE. Social PEPs require ACTIVE; absence denies.

identityClaims.issuerChange: P1-LIVE-006: no issued token carried phase/account_status while social PEPs already required them, so every social request failed closed (500 via the unmapped IllegalStateException path). Issuance now always mints both.

transportSelector.serverCrossCheck: The server must fail closed when the selected transport conflicts with the device class or trusted client context.

webH5.request: Refresh credential is sent only by the HttpOnly-Secure-SameSite cookie.
webH5.response: Refresh credential is returned only by Set-Cookie and is absent from JSON data.

native.request: Refresh credential is an explicit JSON body field on the NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE variant.
native.response: Refresh credential is a required JSON data field on the NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE variant.
native.storage: Keychain-or-Keystore-only; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and any plaintext fallback are prohibited.

x-b8-compatibility.rule: Only iam-service may mint tokens. Compatibility routes are historical-only, cannot mint tokens, and fail closed.

x-b8-iam-policy-governance.authorizationModel: RBAC permission sets plus ABAC policy evaluation

clientAuthority.rule: Client-supplied values are assertions or selectors only. They never establish authorization and cannot expand an allow decision.

principal.source: iam-service derived from a validated IAM JWT, server-owned session/device facts, active policy and revocation state

adultGate.revalidation: required when the authoritative policy, evidence or eligibility state is stale, revoked or otherwise uncertain

consent.authority: iam-service server record bound to a published document version and digest
consent.withdrawal: applies documented restriction, revocation and revalidation effects before protected capability use

pepPdp.normalPath: domain-service local PEP: validated JWT plus local resource facts plus versioned policy bundle or bounded security cache
pepPdp.trustedInternalCaller: service identity is independently authenticated and bound to the PEP service

policyControlPlane.separationOfDuties: A policy author, contributor or submitter cannot independently approve the same version. Activation requires an independently approved immutable version; no client role or approver identifier is trusted.
policyControlPlane.audit: Every read decision and mutating lifecycle action is linked by requestId, traceId, decisionId or auditId.
policyControlPlane.cacheInvalidation: Activation and revocation publish a versioned cache invalidation receipt. PEPs deny protected actions until they can prove a non-revoked applicable policy version.

apiSemantics.errorResponses: ApiBadRequest, ApiUnauthorized, ApiForbidden, ApiNotFound, ApiConflict, ApiUnprocessableEntity, ApiServiceUnavailable or ApiGatewayTimeout as applicable
apiSemantics.idempotency: Every persistent write requires Idempotency-Key; decision and policy-bundle reads do not create a domain fact.

B8ServiceIdentity.description: Internal service JWT only; iam-service independently validates issuer, signature, RS256 algorithm, audience, time window, token_type, service identity and caller-to-PEP binding. A client bearer token, forwarded role header or caller-supplied service name never satisfies this scheme.

B8AuthTransport.name: X-Auth-Transport
B8AuthTransport.description: Authentication credential transport selector. Omission is backward-compatible WEB_COOKIE. NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE must be explicit and is cross-checked by iam-service; it is never authorization evidence.

B8PolicyVersionId.name: policyVersionId
B8PolicyVersionId.description: Server-issued immutable policy-version identifier; it is never a tenant, owner, role or approval authority assertion.

B8PolicyVersionList.description: Cursor page of server-authoritative IAM policy versions visible to the authenticated principal.

B8PolicyVersionCreated.description: A server-owned IAM policy draft has been created with an immutable audit association.

B8PolicyVersionRead.description: A server-authoritative IAM policy version and its lifecycle, separation-of-duties and audit facts.

B8PolicyVersionMutation.description: A policy lifecycle command completed with an immutable audit association and any required cache-invalidation receipt.

B8PolicyBundle.description: Versioned policy bundle for a trusted service-local PEP; unavailable or stale/revoked state must not be treated as an allow.

B8PdpDecision.description: Remote PDP decision for a trusted PEP caller. A transport, policy, revocation or context failure is not an ALLOW decision and the PEP must fail closed.

B8AuthTokensCreated.description: Legacy reusable registration response. The formal request operations use the same B8AuthTokenEnvelope transport discriminator.

x-auth-transport.WEB_COOKIE: Set-Cookie must be emitted and JSON data has no refreshToken
x-auth-transport.NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE: Set-Cookie must be absent and JSON data.refreshToken is required

B8AuthTokens.description: Legacy reusable login/refresh response. The formal request operations use the same B8AuthTokenEnvelope transport discriminator.

x-auth-transport.WEB_COOKIE: Set-Cookie must be emitted and JSON data has no refreshToken
x-auth-transport.NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE: Set-Cookie must be absent and JSON data.refreshToken is required

B8Jwks.description: Public IAM signing keys only; no private key material

B8NoContent.description: Password reset applied; prior sessions and Refresh Token families are revoked.

x-auth-transport.WEB_COOKIE: Set-Cookie clears the matching browser Refresh Token
x-auth-transport.NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE: Set-Cookie is absent and the client clears the Keychain or Keystore credential

B8Unauthorized.description: HTTP 401: account credentials or JWT issuer, signature, algorithm, audience, time window, token type, scope or session is invalid

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge without token or validation details.

B8Forbidden.description: HTTP 403: authenticated principal lacks the server-derived permission

B8AccountLocked.description: Account temporarily locked after failed attempts

B8RefreshCookie.description: WEB_COOKIE variant only: Set-Cookie must set yuxuexing_refresh=<opaque>; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=<positive seconds>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax. It is never emitted by the native variant and is not readable by Web/H5 JavaScript.

B8RefreshCookieClear.description: WEB_COOKIE variant only: Set-Cookie must clear yuxuexing_refresh with yuxuexing_refresh=; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=0; Expires=<past HTTP-date>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax. It is never emitted by the native variant.

B8AuthNoStore.description: Authentication material responses are never stored by shared or browser caches.

B8JwksCacheControl.description: Public JWKS caching is bounded so new and retired kid values converge safely.

B8ErrorEnvelope.description: Compatibility error shape for existing IAM operations. New or migrated operations use ApiErrorEnvelope.

message.description: Non-sensitive localizable message; never echo password, Refresh Token or key material.

B8NativeDeviceInput.description: NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE request device boundary for iOS, Android and native iPad runtimes. The server derives authorization facts independently of this device declaration.

B8WebRefreshRequest.description: WEB_COOKIE refresh input. The opaque Refresh Token is sent only by the HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite cookie; JSON must not contain refreshToken.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; explicit native refresh credential. Store only in Keychain or Keystore; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

resetToken.description: TLS only; one-time credential; 禁止日志或明文持久化。

newPassword.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

B8AuthTokenResponse.x-compatibility-role: Legacy broad token response retained so existing generated-client imports remain source-compatible. New authentication operations use B8AuthTokenEnvelope with an explicit transport discriminator.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT; 禁止日志或 Web storage 保存。

refreshToken.description: TLS only; native-only rotated opaque credential; Web receives an HttpOnly cookie; 禁止日志。

authTransport.description: Optional legacy discriminator. New clients use the required discriminator on B8WebAuthTokenResponse or B8NativeAuthTokenResponse.

B8WebAuthTokenResponse.description: WEB_COOKIE authentication result. Refresh Token is intentionally absent from JSON and is returned only by the HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite Set-Cookie header.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT. Keep in memory only; never log or store in Web storage.

B8NativeAuthTokenResponse.description: NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE authentication result. The explicit Refresh Token is required and may only be written to Keychain or Keystore; all ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT. Keep in memory only; never log or store in ordinary storage.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; rotated opaque credential. Persist only in Keychain or Keystore; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

B8AuthTokenEnvelope.description: Canonical ApiSuccessEnvelope with an explicitly transport-discriminated authentication data payload.

x-client-authority.rule: No request field, role header, tenant field, owner field or client-side gate/consent flag can alter this representation or produce an authorization allow.

principalId.description: Legacy principal identifier, server-derived from the authenticated IAM subject.

tenantId.description: Legacy tenant identifier. The canonical tenant context includes provenance.

policyVersion.description: Legacy active policy version. The canonical policy field includes authority and lifecycle provenance.

deviceId.description: Optional public device id; server generates one when absent.

x-server-decision-required.rule: Confirmation, birth information and a client-selected policy version are input assertions only. They do not authorize a protected capability without a server-derived eligibility decision.

confirmed.description: User assertion required for the flow; it is not an adult-eligibility authorization fact.

birthYear.description: Sensitive user assertion. iam-service evaluates eligibility from server-recognized evidence and policy; this value alone cannot grant access.

policyVersion.description: Presented policy version selector. iam-service verifies it against the active published adult policy instead of trusting the client value.

status.description: Compatibility status. learningAccess is the authoritative protected-capability gate.

learningAccess.description: Server-derived access result. Any missing, revoked, stale or uncertain adult evidence results in RESTRICTED.

policyVersion.description: Published adult-gate policy version selected and verified by iam-service.

policyAsOf.description: Server time at which the adult-gate policy/evidence decision applies.

evidenceDigest.description: Non-reversible digest/reference of evaluated evidence. Raw birth data and evidence are not returned.

restrictionReasons.description: Safe, non-sensitive reason codes when learningAccess is RESTRICTED.

B8PdpAdultGateContext.description: Strict server-authoritative adult context required by the new PDP. The legacy public response keeps its historical required set for additive client compatibility.

version.description: Legacy document version alias. document.version is the authoritative record.

purpose.description: Server-published processing purpose associated with type.

required.description: Whether this consent is required for the evaluated Phase 1 capability.

B8ConsentUpdateRequest.x-server-decision-required: iam-service verifies the published purpose, required flag, document version/digest, prior state and protected-capability effects. The request cannot directly grant access.

expectedDocumentDigest.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency assertion of the published document digest. A mismatch is a conflict/revalidation outcome, never an authorization allow.

accepted.description: Legacy summary. It is true only when all applicable required consent is currently GRANTED and effective.

B8PdpConsentContext.description: Strict required-consent context used by the new PDP; absent or stale facts are denied.

B8JwksResponse.x-jwks-boundary: Public RSA signing keys only; private key material is never exposed. RS256 is the only Phase 1 algorithm.

kid.description: Stable key identifier used to select the RSA/RS256 public key during the documented overlap window.

digest.description: Digest of the server-published consent document, never a client authority value.

B8PdpPrincipalContext.x-trust-boundary: All values are read by the calling PEP from an independently validated IAM JWT/session context and remain subject to IAM PDP validation; client fields cannot populate this object.

B8PdpResourceContext.x-trust-boundary: The calling resource-owner service supplies only facts it owns and signs/attests their provenance through its trusted service identity. IAM denies when owner or tenant provenance is missing or inconsistent.

B8TrustedServiceIdentityContext.x-server-derived: Validated from B8ServiceIdentity, not trusted from an arbitrary body field.

B8PdpAuthorizationDecisionResponse.description: Strict decision payload for the new PDP; compatibility clients may continue reading the legacy decision schema during migration.

B8RolePermissionBinding.description: Versioned RBAC binding. It becomes authoritative only after independent approval and activation of the containing policy version; request payloads never change the caller's current authority.

requiredPermissions.description: Permissions resolved from the active server-side role binding; a client-supplied permission never satisfies this requirement.

B8PolicyDocument.x-policy-language: declarative-only; executable scripts, network callbacks and client-supplied authority expressions are prohibited

roleBindings.description: RBAC permission sets managed through the same immutable, independently approved policy lifecycle.

B8AuthorizationDecisionRequest.description: Compatibility request shape for the deprecated authorization endpoint. New PEP integrations use B8PdpAuthorizationDecisionRequest with a trusted service identity, principal provenance, resource provenance and policy context.

x-client-authority.rule: This compatibility shape cannot establish subject, tenant, owner, roles, permissions, consent, device trust, content rights or policy authority. Missing trusted context fails closed.
